official.application_cycle: Yearly intake; applications accepted on a first-come, first-served basis while the 10 places remain
official.status_note: The official page records Call Status: 'The call is currently open' and states COMSTECH will accept applications on a yearly basis, selecting candidates against pre-approved criteria
benefits: COMSTECH covers low-cost international airfare and visa fees, if applicable
Host institutions provide accommodation and subsistence
Supervision and mentoring of local training at the host institution
eligibility: Citizens of all OIC member states; the page names the OIC least-developed countries including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Benin, Burkina Faso, Chad, Comoros, Djibouti, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Mauritania, Mozambique, Niger, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Somalia, Sudan, Togo, Uganda and Yemen
At least a Bachelor's degree; a Master's or PhD is an asset, with an academic background in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety or another related field
Bachelor's degree holders: at least 5 years of substantive professional experience, preferably in government or national research institutions
Master's or PhD holders: at least 3 years of professional experience, preferably in a government or national research institution
Fluent and proficient in English, with excellent written and oral communication skills
Available full-time (40 hours per week) during the entire duration of the fellowship
Maximum age 35 years (for MS/PhD holders) or 45 years (for post-doctoral researchers)
requirements: Match one of the eight published thematic areas
Meet the degree and experience thresholds for your qualification level
Demonstrate fluency in English - the fellowship is conducted in English
Commit to 40 hours per week, full-time, for the whole placement
Be within the age limit for your level
documents: Completed application submitted through the official application form linked from the COMSTECH page
Evidence of professional experience (5 years post-graduation for Bachelor's holders; 3 years for Master's/PhD holders)
selection_criteria: Scientific merit, assessed by OIC-COMSTECH and the Joint Scholarship Committee of the host institutions
First-come, first-served allocation subject to eligibility - only 10 fellowships are available
coverage: Low-cost international airfare and visa fees, if applicable (COMSTECH)
Accommodation and subsistence at the host institution
Supervision and mentoring of local training
application_method: Review the eight thematic areas and the list of CCoE host institutions published on the COMSTECH page
Complete and submit the official application form linked from the page
Applications are considered on a first-come, first-served basis until the 10 available places are filled
official.application_route: Complete the official application form (Jotform link on the COMSTECH fellowship page); awards are made first-come, first-served, subject to eligibility, while 10 places remain
official.study_mode: Full-time (40 hours per week) for the entire duration
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens of all OIC member states; the page explicitly encourages applicants from OIC least-developed countries
official.international_eligibility: Open to citizens of OIC member states across Africa, the Middle East and Asia; placements are at OIC R&D and higher-education institutions
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Academic background in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety or a related field, matching one of eight thematic areas: Plant Biotechnology; Human Nutrition; The Water-Food-Energy Nexus; Food Science and Technology; Nutraceuticals/Food-Medicine Continuum; Agro-Business, Trade, Food Value Chains; Agricultural Technology and Innovations; Neglected Food Crops
official.research_requirement: Short- to medium-term research placement (3 to 6 months) in advanced institutions, building technical capacity in agriculture, food security and related areas
official.duration: 3 to 6 months, extendable upon recommendation from the host institution
official.description: COMSTECH and prestigious CCoE member institutions jointly offer research fellowships to young researchers in OIC countries for short- to medium-term research placements (3 to 6 months) in advanced institutions, aiming to build technical capacity in agriculture, food security and related areas and empower early-career professionals.
official.english_requirement: Fluent and proficient in English, with excellent written and oral communication skills; the fellowship is conducted in the English language.

applicant_utility.summary: Ten fellowships, first-come first-served: here being early matters as much as being good, and there is no closing date to hide behind. If you are an OIC-country researcher in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety or nutrition who can commit to full-time work at a host centre of excellence, COMSTECH flies you there and the host provides accommodation and subsistence. The practical move is to apply the moment a round opens, with your experience evidence already assembled.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Early-career food-security, agriculture, food science or nutrition researchers from OIC states who can commit 40 hours a week for three to six months.
application_readiness_checklist: Map your profile to one of the eight published thematic areas before opening the form
Confirm your experience meets the years-of-experience rule for your degree level
Complete the application form linked from the COMSTECH page as early as possible
Prepare dated evidence of qualifications and professional experience in ready-to-upload form
common_rejection_risks: Applying late - only 10 fellowships exist, allocated first-come, first-served, and delay spends the chance
A background not aligned to any of the thematic areas
Falling short of the experience rule (5 years post-graduation for Bachelor's holders; 3 years for Master's/PhD holders)
Inability to commit 40 hours per week for the entire placement
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition or enrolment fees are not part of the published package (airfare, visa fees, accommodation, subsistence, supervision and mentoring are); personal expenses and any institutional fees are self-funded.
document_audit: The application runs through the form linked on the COMSTECH page - incomplete forms simply never enter the queue
Keep experience evidence specific and dated, since the 3/5-year thresholds are checked
English fluency is assumed: the fellowship is conducted in English, so be ready to demonstrate written and oral skills
alerts: The call is currently open with no closing date; 10 fellowships fill first-come, first-served
Choose deliberately between COMSTECH programmes - only one application per calendar year is workable
Duration is 3-6 months, extendable only on the host institution's recommendation
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the application form linked from the COMSTECH fellowship page; COMSTECH and the host institutions' Joint Scholarship Committee select on scientific merit as applications arrive.
